attchmntText: Universus Photo Imagings Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of unaudited Financial Results for the Second Quarter and half Year ended on September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Universus Photo Imagings Limited submitted newspaper cuttings to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited regarding the publication of unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2026. The results were published in Financial Express and Jansatta on November 14, 2026. This submission complies with Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The filing was made by Suresh Kumar, Company Secretary.

attchmntText: Universus Photo Imagings Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper publication of unaudited Financial Results for the Second Quarter and  half Year ended on September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Universus Photo Imagings Limited submitted newspaper cuttings to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited. The submission confirms the publication of unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2026. The results were published in the Financial Express and Jansatta newspapers on November 14, 2026. This filing is made in accordance with Regulation 47 and other applicable provisions of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The document serves as a record for the exchanges.

attchmntText: Universus Photo Imagings Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the Unaudited financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Universus Photo Imagings Limited announced the outcome of its Board of Directors meeting held on 13th November 2026. The Board approved the Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Limited Review Reports from Statutory Auditors Suresh Kumar Mittal and Co were also approved. Standalone revenue for the quarter was Rs 357 lakhs, with a profit before tax of Rs 163 lakhs. Earnings per share stood at Rs 1.25. For the half year, standalone revenue was Rs 1,292 lakhs, and profit before tax was Rs 821 lakhs. Half year earnings per share were Rs 6.35. The company reported total assets of Rs 69,113 lakhs as of 30th September 2026. The meeting commenced at 03:30 P.M and concluded at 05:00 P.M.

Universus Photo Imagings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  Mr. Devendra Singh Rawat (DIN: 09696674) as an Additional Director in the category of Non-Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 04, 2026.
